entities.summary: Guangwu, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Qin and Han Dynasties (25–220). Preceded by Yellow Turban Rebellion and Emperor Wu adopts Confucianism as the state ideology. Their legacy influenced Cai Lun improves papermaking — one of China's Four Great Inventions and Zhang Qian's missions open the Silk Road to Central Asia.
